red_observations.observation: The API capacity preview passed, but the lifecycle worker failed closed before creating any seat resource because its model preflight could not reach Granite Tools.
red_observations.failure: Model endpoint unreachable at http://vllm-granite-3-2-8b-tools.fleet-llm-d.svc:8080/v1 after 3 attempt(s): connection error
red_observations.root_cause: The model ingress policies admitted the backend pod identity but omitted the lifecycle-worker pod identity introduced by process HA.

red_observations.observation: Retry changed the workshop to queued but reused the already-succeeded lifecycle job and therefore no worker could claim new work.
red_observations.root_cause: Workshop provision retries reused the v1 idempotency key instead of advancing a persisted provision generation.

remediation.network_policy: Allow both backend and lifecycle-worker pod identities to reach Granite Tools and Nomic embedding endpoints.
remediation.retry_contract: Increment lifecycle_provision_generation before enqueue so each failed-workshop retry creates a new claimable durable job.
remediation.deployment_state: Code remediation is GREEN-local and pending immutable image build and Arena rollout.
